domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's leave application. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, approval/rejection, and potential cancellation. References the employee, the leave type (policy), and the approving/rejecting/cancelling actor.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — initial state; employee is composing the request; not yet visible to managers; editable by the employee
SUBMITTED — employee has submitted for review; visible to the manager; awaiting manager action; employee cannot edit
APPROVED — manager has approved the leave; balance has been deducted; employee may still cancel (with balance restoration)
REJECTED — manager has rejected the leave; terminal state (no further transitions); balance is unaffected
CANCELLED — the request has been cancelled; can be reached from DRAFT (employee discards), SUBMITTED (employee withdraws), or APPROVED (employee cancels approved leave; balance is restored)

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining balance for a specific leave type within a fiscal year. Deducted when a leave request is approved; restored when an approved leave is cancelled. Each (employee, leaveType, fiscalYear) tuple is unique.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is in effect for the current fiscal year; deductions and restorations are permitted
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays has reached zero; no further approvals can be granted for this leave type this fiscal year unless balance is restored via cancellation
FROZEN — balance is temporarily frozen (e.g., employee on long-term leave, investigation); no deductions or restorations permitted
CLOSED — fiscal year has ended; balance is archived and read-only; a new balance is created for the next fiscal year

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organisation. Holds identity, reporting-line (managerId), and employment lifecycle state. Employment status gates all leave operations — only ACTIVE employees may submit leave requests.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — employee is currently employed and eligible for leave; all leave operations are permitted
INACTIVE — employee is on extended leave or suspension; leave requests are blocked; existing approved leave remains valid
TERMINATED — employment has ended; all leave balances are frozen; no new requests permitted; historical data retained for audit

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Governs how many days an employee is entitled to, whether manager approval is required, minimum notice periods, and accrual behaviour. Referenced by LeaveBalance to determine entitlements and by LeaveRequest to validate compliance.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect; governs leave requests of its type; entitlements are calculated from it
INACTIVE — policy is disabled; no new leave requests can reference it; existing balances under this policy remain valid until fiscal year end
ARCHIVED — policy has been superseded or retired; read-only; retained for historical audit

domain_entities.name: Notification
domain_entities.purpose: Represents a notification sent to a user (employee or manager) in response to leave-related events: request submitted, approved, rejected, or cancelled. Links back to the originating entity for traceability.
lifecycle_states: PENDING — notification has been created but not yet delivered
SENT — notification has been delivered to the recipient
READ — recipient has acknowledged/read the notification
ARCHIVED — notification is no longer relevant; hidden from default views

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type may be governed by a distinct LeavePolicy. The feature scope covers annual, sick, and emergency; unpaid, maternity, and paternity are defined for completeness.

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequestStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of states a LeaveRequest can occupy. Drives the leave request lifecycle state machine. Transitions: DRAFT→SUBMITTED, DRAFT→CANCELLED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED, SUBMITTED→REJECTED, SUBMITTED→CANCELLED, APPROVED→CANCELLED. REJECTED is terminal.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalanceStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of states a LeaveBalance can occupy. Transitions: ACTIVE→EXHAUSTED (remainingDays hits 0), EXHAUSTED→ACTIVE (balance restored via cancellation), ACTIVE→FROZEN (admin action), FROZEN→ACTIVE (admin unfreeze), ACTIVE→CLOSED (fiscal year end), EXHAUSTED→CLOSED (fiscal year end), FROZEN→CLOSED (fiscal year end). CLOSED is terminal.

domain_entities.name: EmploymentStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of employment states. Gates all leave operations. Transitions: ACTIVE→INACTIVE (suspension/extended leave), INACTIVE→ACTIVE (reinstatement), ACTIVE→TERMINATED (employment ends), INACTIVE→TERMINATED (termination while inactive). TERMINATED is terminal.

domain_entities.name: NotificationType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of notification categories triggered by leave lifecycle events. Each type maps to a specific domain event and determines the notification template and routing.

business_rules: BR-001 — Employment status gate: Only employees with employmentStatus = ACTIVE may submit a leave request. INACTIVE and TERMINATED employees are blocked from creating or submitting leave requests.

BR-002 — Sufficient balance check: Before a LeaveRequest transitions from DRAFT to SUBMITTED, the system must verify that the employee has a LeaveBalance with remainingDays >= the requested number of days for the corresponding leaveType and fiscalYear. If no balance exists or remainingDays is insufficient, the submission is rejected.

BR-003 — Balance deduction on approval: When a LeaveRequest transitions from SUBMITTED to APPROVED, the corresponding LeaveBalance.usedDays is incremented by the leave duration (endDate - startDate + 1 in working days), and remainingDays is recalculated as totalEntitlement - usedDays. If remainingDays reaches zero, the balance transitions to EXHAUSTED.

BR-004 — Balance restoration on cancellation: When a LeaveRequest transitions from APPROVED to CANCELLED, the corresponding LeaveBalance.usedDays is decremented by the leave duration, and remainingDays is recalculated. If the balance was EXHAUSTED, it transitions back to ACTIVE.

BR-005 — Manager approval requirement: If the LeavePolicy referenced by the LeaveRequest has requiresManagerApproval = true, the request MUST be approved by the employee's manager (Employee.managerId). The system must validate that approvedBy matches the employee's managerId. If the employee has no manager (managerId is null), the request is auto-escalated or blocked depending on policy configuration.

BR-006 — Minimum notice period: When a LeaveRequest is submitted, if the LeavePolicy.minimumNoticeDays is set, the system must verify that startDate is at least minimumNoticeDays in the future from the submission date. Emergency leave (leaveType = emergency) is exempt from this rule.

BR-007 — Date validity: startDate must be on or before endDate. The leave duration is calculated as the number of working days (excluding weekends and public holidays) between startDate and endDate inclusive. A zero or negative duration is invalid.

BR-008 — No overlapping approved leave: When a LeaveRequest is submitted, the system must verify that the employee has no other APPROVED LeaveRequest whose date range overlaps with the new request. Overlapping approved leave of any type is not permitted.

BR-009 — Fiscal year alignment: Each LeaveBalance is scoped to a single fiscalYear. When a LeaveRequest spans two fiscal years, the system must split the deduction across the two corresponding LeaveBalance records proportionally by the number of days falling in each fiscal year. If either balance is insufficient, the request is rejected.
BR-010 — Policy active check: A LeaveRequest may only reference a LeavePolicy whose lifecycle state is ACTIVE. Referencing an INACTIVE or ARCHIVED policy is rejected at submission time.
domain_notes:
## Lifecycle States Introduced

### LeaveRequest
- **DRAFT** → initial; employee composing; editable; not visible to managers
- **SUBMITTED** → awaiting manager action; not editable by employee
- **APPROVED** → balance deducted; employee may still cancel
- **REJECTED** → terminal; balance unaffected
- **CANCELLED** → reached from DRAFT (discard), SUBMITTED (withdraw), or APPROVED (cancel with balance restoration)

### LeaveBalance
- **ACTIVE** → deductions and restorations permitted
- **EXHAUSTED** → remainingDays = 0; no further approvals until restored
- **FROZEN** → temporarily blocked (admin action); no mutations
- **CLOSED** → fiscal year ended; read-only; terminal

### Employee (EmploymentStatus)
- **ACTIVE** → all leave operations permitted
- **INACTIVE** → leave requests blocked; existing approved leave valid
- **TERMINATED** → all balances frozen; no new requests; terminal

### LeavePolicy
- **ACTIVE** → governs leave requests; entitlements calculated from it
- **INACTIVE** → no new requests can reference it; existing balances remain
- **ARCHIVED** → read-only; retained for audit; terminal

### Notification
- **PENDING** → created, not yet delivered
- **SENT** → delivered to recipient
- **READ** → acknowledged by recipient
- **ARCHIVED** → hidden from default views; terminal

## Cross-Entity Business Rules Summary
- BR-001: Only ACTIVE employees may submit leave
- BR-002: Sufficient balance check at submission
- BR-003: Balance deduction on approval
- BR-004: Balance restoration on cancellation
- BR-005: Manager approval enforcement (with null-manager escalation)
- BR-006: Minimum notice period (emergency leave exempt)
- BR-007: Date validity and working-day duration calculation
- BR-008: No overlapping approved leave
- BR-009: Cross-fiscal-year proportional balance deduction
- BR-010: Only ACTIVE policies may be referenced
